title: fix(update): clear applying status after a handed-off update finishes
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: update status keeps showing an automatic update as applying after its handed-off run has already finished, including a preflight failure that leaves the original Gateway running.

## User Impact

Operators see that the update has finished instead of an indefinitely busy campaign. Active updates and unrelated campaigns remain intact. This does not repair the underlying update failure, change updater admission, or introduce a schema/configuration migration.

## Why This Change Was Made

The campaign owner now reconciles durable terminal outcomes before status responses and terminal watcher events. Both automatic admission and manual adoption retain the exact campaign run, so newer unrelated history cannot hide its completion. The owner rechecks campaign identity after asynchronous reads to preserve a replacement campaign.

This is backend lifecycle reconciliation, separate from the active-run presentation change in #155342; no UI rendering code changes.

## Evidence

Candidate: `c97b1918b3ce901666b50691e23e494a0fe023aa` (GitHub-verified signature).

- Fresh AutoReview completed with **scoped-clean**, exit 0, no P0–P2 findings. All eleven changed-file snapshots and the canonical full-index patch matched the published candidate byte-for-byte. Patch SHA-256: `e01aeaef1467966a55a1c2f121b1ee214bacfff5ab3ee085727a5a3a1d08eae5`. This is independent source review, not runtime proof.
- Addressed ClawSweeper's exact-run lookup failure finding: retain the available status response and pending campaign on read failure; a later successful status read reconciles it. A deterministic failure/recovery regression accompanies the fix.
- Prior proof: 84 focused tests across `update-status.test.ts`, `update-run-campaign.test.ts`, `update-run-watcher.test.ts`, `update-campaign.test.ts`, and `update-startup.campaign-apply-error.test.ts`; targeted type-aware lint on the original eight changed TypeScript files passed. Unchanged-surface proof is retained. The repaired status-file suite passed all 24 tests (80.46 seconds wrapper; 73.80 seconds Vitest; new failure/recovery case 690 ms). Targeted typed lint passed with zero warnings/errors (52.4 seconds); all three subsequent test-only repair surfaces passed in current-head hosted CI.
- Exact-head CI on the preceding commit exposed three test-contract issues, now fixed without production changes: preserve the real synchronous package-root resolver in the interruption fixture, model repeated schedule reads with stable state, and supply required `expectDefined` diagnostic labels. The original failures are recorded in [CI #36112172149](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36112172149); replacement-head validation passed for all three surfaces in [CI #36113666012](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36113666012).
- Prior measured single-worker runs: Gateway shard 60 tests / 151.72 seconds; infra shard 24 tests / 32.74 seconds; combined wrapper 192.07 seconds. Current-head config-shard diagnostic retry: one file passed in 230.88 seconds, including the formerly timed-out include-only case in 3.689 seconds.
- Isolated published-driver-to-candidate acceptance passed in [Package Acceptance #36111829281](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36111829281), with exact baseline `openclaw@2026.9.6`, production-identical candidate `6e1b6eead45adc1e9f2ab2ca1e5580a746fabe38`, and `legacy-operator-state`. Harness revision: `942a27def95d224a72794e3641f63b4889f85259`. Inspected artifact [`docker-e2e-published-upgrade-survivor`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36111829281/artifacts/10855795053): one attempt, exit 0, 985 seconds, updater installation, `updateOutcome=success`, manual restart. Legacy state survival, first-hop cron ownership, candidate schemas/migration, Gateway health/readiness/RPC, agent/plugin operation, no-op update, and backup/rollback assertions passed. Startup 34 seconds; health/readiness 1 second each; status 3 seconds.

**CI and limitations:** ordinary exact-head [CI #36113666012](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36113666012) passed on attempt 2. Attempt 1 had 118 successful jobs but a 180-second config-patch include-only lifecycle-hook timeout. The identical shard and case had passed on the preceding production-identical commit; after source/fixture inspection, one diagnostic single-job retry passed the full file and final gate. The original timeout remains unresolved as a reliability limitation; this is not a flake-free claim. Upgrade acceptance passed on the preceding production-identical commit, not the current test-only head; the diff to the final head contains only three test-fixture changes. This is manual-restart proof, not automatic authenticated-restart proof. The harness marks `firstHopPostCore` unavailable because no complete exit snapshot was captured; it does not provide a complete first-hop terminal-status trace. Full local build/typecheck/test suites have not been run. The local behavior evidence is backend RPC/ledger and watcher coverage, not browser or deployed-Gateway proof. No live/operator Gateway was restarted or updated. The isolated Docker fixture exercised its own Gateway lifecycle.
